image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of an African crocodile (Nile crocodile) resting on sandy ground. The image focuses on the head and upper torso, showing detailed skin texture, armored scutes, a closed eye with visible eyelid structure, and interlocking teeth along the jawline. The lighting is natural, casting shadows that emphasize the rough texture of the osteoderms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nostrils, forming a V-shape characteristic of crocodiles rather than the U-shape of alligators. The head structure appears broad and robust.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple conical teeth are clearly visible protruding from the lower jaw even though the mouth is mostly closed. The fourth tooth on the lower jaw appears to fit into a notch on the upper jaw, consistent with crocodile anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is positioned on top of the head. While the pupil shape is hard to definitively confirm as a vertical slit due to resolution/lighting, the dorsal positioning is correct. The eye appears covered by a translucent layer or lid, consistent with a nictitating membrane or closed state.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostrils are clearly visible at the very end of the snout, allowing for breathing while submerged.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows thick, rugged skin indicative of heavy armor. The elongation is implied by the perspective leading back from the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture is highly detailed, showing distinct, raised bony plates (scutes) arranged in rows along the back and neck.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of earthy browns, greens, and greys. The texture is visibly rough and granular, matching the description of osteoderms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral (belly) side is not visible in this angle; the crocodile is lying on its stomach on the sand.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs and feet are completely occluded by the body and the angle of the shot, or are outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in this close-up crop of the head and shoulders.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific species classification (Nile crocodile vs. other crocodilians) based on fine-grained features like snout shape and scute pattern.
To analyze the complex texture of the scutes for any signs of AI-generated smoothing, repetition, or 'melting' artifacts common in detailed organic surfaces.
To ensure the teeth are distinct, separate entities and not fused with the jaw or gum line, a common failure point in AI generation.

focus_areas: Tooth integrity and separation from gums
Scute texture realism and lack of repetitive patterns
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the teeth and the jawbone. AI often blurs this boundary. Also, check if the scute patterns show any unnatural tiling or repetition which would indicate a generative artifact. Verify that the eye reflection and structure look biologically plausible.
